body:
Stopped before claiming and added `blocked`: `#2160` waits on its required prerequisites `#2158`, `#2159`, and `#1862`.

Checked `upstream/main` at `e3f7d122b3c7fb86aff4c893667f02378fc707d8` and all 56 open PRs in `NeoTech/Camcraft`:

- `#2158` (open, `claimed` at `2026-11-16T19:18:23Z` on `mkinney:issue/2158-nesting-kernel`, `effort:max`): no `crates/geometry/src/nesting` module exists on `upstream/main`, no branch is pushed to `origin`, and no open PR exists yet.
- `#2159` (open, unclaimed, `effort:max`): no open PR exists yet for the global sheet cut-order tree and parts-in-holes safety in `camcraft-geometry` (itself depends on `#2158`).
- `#1862` (open, `in-review`, PR `#2134`): `Sketch` entity and `EntityKind::Sketch` are not on `upstream/main` (`crates/app/src/schema.rs` has no `Sketch`, and `crates/app/src/project/file.rs` is at `PROJECT_VERSION = 64`). PR `#2134` is open with label `conflicts` and unmerged.
- Material presets (`#1521`, `#1881`, `#1886`): `#1881` (`WaterjetCutData` / `CuttingRow::waterjet`) is on `upstream/main`, while `#1521` and `#1886` remain open.

Without `#2158` and `#2159` in `camcraft-geometry` (and `#1862`'s `Sketch` entity), `NestDef`, `NestLayout`, per-`ChainId` overrides, and `RunNesting` cannot be implemented inside `#2160` without exceeding scope and duplicating `#2158`/`#2159`, and neither `#2158` nor `#2159` has an open PR to stack on.

Prospective file overlap note for later (`crates/app/src/schema.rs`, `project/{file,entity,apply}.rs`, `commands/mod.rs`, `lib.rs`): open PRs `#2187`, `#2162`, `#2157`, `#2149`, `#2136`, `#2134`, `#2122`, `#2100`, `#2092`, `#2077`, `#2024`, `#1738`, `#1681`, `#1209`.

No claim, branch, worktree, code change, or PR was created. Drop `blocked` once `#2158`, `#2159`, and `#1862` are on `upstream/main`.
Unblocked: the blockers #2158, #2159 and #1862 are closed (completed). This issue can be picked again.
